description: Get market price history for an event Returns recorded price changes for the requested markets and sportsbooks, subject to your plan's historical-data access. Data can be available before, during, or after an event as prices are recorded. Each response is bounded by the requested limit. Read-only Product data or price calculation. Use returned canonical IDs. Access, delay and metered usage follow your connected account; never infer coverage from an empty result. One bounded request, no background polling or automatic retry. Affiliate 27 is excluded. No wagers, account changes or guarantee of returns.

eventID.description: Canonical V2 event ID from the `event_id` field returned by event endpoints

affiliate_ids.description:
Comma-separated sportsbook/affiliate IDs to filter. Common values include DraftKings (19), FanDuel (23), BetMGM (22), BookMaker (7), BetCRIS (9), Pinnacle (3), Polymarket US (31), Circa Sports (32), Bet105 (33), and Heritage Sports (34). Availability varies by sport and market.
On V2 event endpoints (`/api/v2/sports/{sportID}/events/{date}`, `/api/v2/events/{eventID}`, and their openers/closing siblings), `affiliate_ids=0` is a scores-only sentinel: the response keeps events, scores, and status and omits markets and price objects. Other endpoints that share this parameter treat `affiliate_ids` as a sportsbook filter only.
 Comma-separated integer IDs; maximum 10, unique, no spaces or encoded aliases. Affiliate 27 is excluded.

limit.description: Maximum total rows across all requested markets and sportsbooks. Invalid or out-of-range values use 1000.

main_line.description: When `true`, return only history rows (or chart points) that were the sportsbook's main line when written — `is_main_line` = true on history rows, `m` = true on chart points. Sorted by time, each change of the line value for a participant is a main-line move at that timestamp.

market_ids.description: Comma-separated market IDs to filter. Defaults to `1,2,3`; maximum 12. Comma-separated integer IDs; maximum 12, unique, no spaces or encoded aliases.

name: v2GetMarketHistoryByEvent
title: Get market price history for an event
